answer: Admission uses a quadratic fee per funding source: the k-th identity funded from one wallet cluster must lock 2k^2 POA for 40 epochs, so ten fakes lock 770 POA while ten honest users in separate clusters lock 20. Each epoch a public beacon picks 7 auditors by hash to replay one claimed task; a vertex in the funding graph with more than 3 linked accounts is merged into one cluster. A fable of independent users fails once the ledger replay shows shared origins, and the whole cluster bond is slashed 70%.
